messages:
tara: quick draft for arclight hw partner SEV flow — trying to keep it short. posting checklist + bot behavior for review.

sam: nice. can you show channel naming + who gets pinged automatically?

tara: channel: `#partner-arclight-sev-<YYYYMMDD>-<id>` created by partners-bot on PD SEV trigger. auto-invite: ops-oncall, partners-liaison, arclight-tech, arclight-ops, tara. pinned runbook snippet + contact CSV.

diego: remind me — do partners get access to our private slack workspace or shared channel only? legal asked about data exposure.

nisha: we do shared channel with limited message retention; set retention to 7 days for these channels. add note to pin: "sensitive logs -> use secure transfer (S3 presigned) not paste".

partners-bot: created channel `#partner-arclight-sev-20241102-42` and added ops-oncall, partners-liaison, @arclight-tech

tara: escalation matrix (short):
- SEV1 PD -> create channel + call bridge
- If partner doesn't ack <8m -> escalate to partner pager
- After 20m no ack -> apply fallback routing (region failover / model variant)
- >24h -> daily status post until handback

sam: can bot enforce the 8m ack? automate pings to oncall and partner pager?

tara: yes. bot will post ephemeral reminders at 4m and 7m then escalate. also records ack timestamps into incident metadata.

diego: what about postmortem ownership? if root cause on arclight infra they lead and we co-author; if our model or runtime then redwood leads. add SLA impact calc.

tara: added handback -> owner selection rule and SLA calc snippet. also added marketing comms step: if outage >1h and customer-visible, partners-liaison to draft joint statement within 2h.

nisha: add CSV template for partner contacts (PD id, pager, slack handle, region). paste below.

```
partner_name,partner_pager,partner_slack,partner_pd_id,region
Arclight,+15551234567,@arclight-tech,PDR12345,us-west-2
```

sam: small ask: make sure bot disables ephemeral channel creation for non-SLA partners (flag in onboarding). else we spam.

tara: good catch. added `create_channel: true/false` flag in partner profile. default false. onboarding to set.

partners-bot: scheduled job: close `#partner-arclight-sev-20241102-42` after 7 days of inactivity; daily status checks at 09:00 UTC.

diego: looks solid. please push to partnerships playbook and add to partner onboarding checklist.

tara: will do. final call: approve to share with legal & support?

nisha: approve from my side.

sam: approve.

tara: thanks all — i'll post link once it's live.
